You'll have to excuse me for not being more accommodating...
It's been quite some time since my vitality has left me.
How can I help you?
\PN handed over the Ribbon Collar.

LOTTIE: ...I see.

Scarlett...

LOTTIE: That's...
That's lovely to hear.
LOTTIE: I see...
I suppose keeping her away from here would be best.
I know as well as any that my daughter was not as kind to her as she could have been.
But one can only lead a Horsea to water.
...I suppose in the end, she fell in.
Thank you for taking the time to bring me what you've found.
Please take good care of Scarborough.

I don't exactly make it out to the Department Store much these days.

CORIN-ROUGE: Oh?
Charming!
Dazzling!
Utterly breath-stealing!
The astonishing display of beauty can only mean one thing!
Rest assured, my god-sculpted suitor, I shall run from you no longer.
You've chased me all the way here.
That's perfectly fine.
Because, I am but a fake Corin-Rouge!
There's no way that the real one could ever be caught in your positively magnetic eyes as I now am.
There's no way that the real one could ever be caught by you!
However! If you are able to defeat me, I'll give you a hint as to where the real one might be!
Be still, my beating heart...
Ah, that I could not do more...
Nevertheless, I am as overwhelmed by you now as I was by you upon first sight,
And as I hope I might one day again be in more intimate terms.
But enough of that!
As promised, I'll give you a hint for where to find the true Corin-Rouge!
Find him in a place where Trainers fight!
That's all you'll get from me!
Hey there! Are you having fun out here in the ocean?
Okay, maybe it's not actually an ocean.
It's an ocean in my heart.
Hello there!
I'm researching the geological history of the Reborn Region!
Interested?
Wonderful! Let's start with this. Did you know that long ago, Ametrine Mountain used to be a volcano?
But that's not all! Pyrous Mountain in Apophyll used to be as frigid as Ametrine now is!
Legends from an old civilization say that the day their civilization ended was the day that Giratina came to Reborn.
They say the dragon was in a frenzy, and all around it bizarre things would happen.
Objects would disappear, lands would be spun upside down, and whole towns were transported across the region in the blink of an eye.
According to the stories, by the time the dimensional warrior finally settled in the south-east of the region, its chaos had already sealed the fate of Reborn.
Ametrine froze, and every speck of magma turned into crystal clear ice water.
Pyrous erupted all at once, a volley of smoke and snow upheaved from its peak.
The lava bled down the slope, burning away what traces of lives had been there in what is now Apophyll.
And in the months to follow, the rising temperatures thawed the snow, which formed what is now Azurine Lake,
Burying their old city beneath it.
I hear some divers can still find artifacts from those days down there!
As for Giratina...
I wonder what could have happened to it? The records about it ended there.
Ohmigod, it's YOU!
I've seen you on TV-- you know, Gossip Gardevoir's show? Introduce me sometime!
But she's showed us all about how you've been fighting Team Meteor and saving Reborn!
That's SO cool!
Oh my god, can I do something to help you?
Anything? Wait! I know!
I have a Sticker! It's not much!
In fact I feel like a little kid saying that... But surely it can be of some small use, right?
\PN obtained a Department Store Sticker!
Think of me whenever you use it!
Oh, and you should take this, too!
Wait, what do you mean you don't have a Department Store Card!?
You've been kicking ass in Reborn for HOW long and you haven't gotten one yet?
You just gotta fix that!
And then! Aaah!
I can be your first...
...Uh, first Sticker-giver! That's what I meant!
Don't read too far into it!
Think of me whenever you go to that store!
I moved out to Apophyll when things started getting rough, and I was excited to come back now that they're better.
But somehow, I miss it out there?
Maybe I'll go back-- of my own free will this time.
Kiki would be proud if I decided to do that, right?
I wish I could get the ring back, but the ring was custom set, so I can't just buy an identical one,
and of course there's no chance I'd be able to find it in the lake.
Ugggh, what am I going to do?
My relationship is over.
No,
My life is over.
I'm going to die of embarrassment.
Sorry, I'll start from the beginning.
My fiancee and I had a little... misunderstanding?
I thought they were cheating on me, so when I got mad, I flung my engagement ring out into the lake.
The truth was cleared up later, and everything's okay with us now,
But I haven't told them that I lost the ring yet.
I've never felt regret like this...
I wish I could fix it, but the ring was custom set, so I can't just buy an identical one,
And of course there's no chance I'd be able to find it in the lake.
Hey, wait...
That ring you've got there... There's no way...
Did you really find it!?
That's incredible!
You are a true savior!
To be honest, I chanced across something interesting, and I was considering doing something drastic in order to pay for a custom replacement.
But since you found it, why don't you take this instead?
I don't really know what that's about either, but at least I won't have to be responsible for it now.
Hopefully you can find a use for it!
Thank you for finding my ring!
Oh, and as for that other thing, could you not mention that to anyone?

In order to make up for the Aqua Gang's past transgressions, I'll do everything I can to make this garden great!
Everyone in the community came together to patch up old alleys and make a place we could be proud of.
I'd say we've done a pretty good job. How about you?

Many travelers come here to survey Tourmaline Desert before they venture out into it.
Are you the same way?
Then take a good look.
If you follow the rail north, you'll come up on the Scrapyard.
Numerous trains have been derailed there and no one has been able to clean them up.
Careful not to go too far north though! Those sandstorms can get mighty fierce, and it's not safe for people to travel in on foot.
Further south of that, there's supposed to be a cave buried under the sands somewhere.
In the north-east, I hear other Trainers can see an old tower, but I've never seen it personally.
And finally, those mountains in the north-west-- those are the Teknite Mountains!
I'm fixin' to hike those myself!
Hi. Don't mind me, I'm just people-watching.
They run around like everything they do is so important.
Then again, it's not like I'm any better.
Always watching, never doing.
Hmm. So they need help at the Coral Gym?
I guess it's my turn to do something after all.
COREY: The view of the desert is just wonderful, don't you think?
COREY: It's been a while, \PN.
Is Heather well? Are you well?
Ah, but this must be very confusing for you.
Come, enjoy the view with me; I'll explain what's going on.
COREY: I died.
But Shade ensured a small part of me still remained.
Not enough to be meaningful, of course, but...
Well, many things that meant nothing began to mean a lot with the creation of the New World.
And here I am.
I've been watching you explore the New World, you know.
Helping Pokémon, and even helping people.
I keep just missing you, though.
I've been trying to track you down, so after all this time...
After all this time, I can finally...
Apologize.
COREY: I said some hurtful things to you in my darkest hour.
Know that you aren't responsible for my actions and choices.
I needed to say that.
COREY: ...So, I hear you met my wife?
Elena, the Skyspectre.
She was my world; and the day I lost her, my world ended.
But... losing one's own life brings a sense of clarity.
Even if all I have are memories of her, I'm still the luckiest man to have ever lived.
She was just unstoppable.
Whether it was battling, or just her day to day life, she could do anything she wanted.
She's the reason I love this view.
She had a rather macabre sense of humor, you see.
We'd often come out here for dates.
At the mildest inconvenience, she'd jump off the bridge, only to fly back up on her Salamence moments later.
If there were any particularly concerned onlookers, she'd even send up a Ghost Type first just to freak them out.
I'm pretty sure that's the entire reason she chose Ghost as her second type.
She really was just... perfect.
COREY: I could talk forever about how wonderful she was.
About how much I miss her.
But I'll have plenty of time to reminisce later.
Elena was so... unfailingly hopeful for the future.
And I think I finally see it.
Reborn is healing.
The people of Reborn are healing.
And the region has the finest Champion it ever has.
I can't help but wonder, though...
She was always so certain that I would be the next Champion.
Perhaps I would have been!
I was quite talented, you know.
At least, I was before she...
Well, before I gave up trying.
But I've had time to try again while wandering the New World.
Not very long, of course but...
Elena always compared me to those child Champions of other regions.
The ones who get their first Pokémon and are Champion a week later.
With how quickly I picked up battling, she was convinced I could've been that for Reborn if I started a decade or two earlier.
But better late than never, right?
The future of Reborn is bright with you at the helm, \PN.
But she believed in me so much...
It would be a disservice to her to not believe in myself at least as much.
I think we are long overdue a fight.
A fair fight.
One where I'm not filled with despair. Or rage. Or murderous intent.
One where I try...
Where I remember the love for battle I had forgotten.
So bring it on, Champion \PN.
Let's see if you would've been able to take the title from me if I had've gotten it first!
COREY: Brilliant!
But don't get comfortable.
By the time I have all the badges to challenge you officially, I'll be at least twice as good!
COREY: Wait, no, I...
What's happening?
I don't want to go back to--
COREY: \PN.
When did you get here?
Did you come to kill me again?
Did you want a repeat show?
Take another swing at poisoning my daughter's mind against me?
Or perhaps you just wanted to show up and make a terrorist group get desperate and sloppy again?
COREY: Things were more dangerous for everyone because of you.
Everything you touch turns toxic.
Truly, a fitting Champion for this region.
COREY: Ace. Solaris. Me.
People died because Meteor got desperate.
Animals are most dangerous when they're cornered.
Make no mistake, their deaths-- and the countless others Meteor caused-- are your fault.
And you could traipse through the New World and find every single one of them, if you wanted.
But nothing would change.
Their blood will always be on your hands.
I am naught but poison to those around me.
But you are poison to everything.
And I will make sure you never have the satisfaction of saving everyone.
You'll never get to pat yourself on the back for that.
COREY: Because one will still always be gone.
And it will always be your fault.
COREY: Elena, my darling...
I came here every day...
Hoping I'd see you fly up on that Salamence once more...
But I know you can't come back to me.
But perhaps... I can come back to you...?
I wanted to go chasing the horizon with you one more time...
Fly a little faster, darling...
Just a little more, and I'd swear we could reach out and touch the moon.
Hail, Trainer.
City watch is on the look-out for trouble. If you see anything suspicious, please report it to us.
I could sit here and stare at the water with you until we wither away.
If we leave it in the hands of the young...
This world is going to be just fine, isn't it?
Gotta hand it to xem, that Adrienn character really knows how to take a mess, and fix it into something great!
Before everything happened, Beryl used to just be a pile of houses.
It takes some real creativity to see a mangle of rubble and roots and say "This should be a park!"
Tch, I don't suppose you wanna hang out, do you?
I feel like parks in the middle of the night should be a rad place to meet people.
But other than you, the only person I've seen here so far is a stupid hobo! Ew!
Hmph, being back after all this time feels weird.
After my home was destroyed, I decided to leave on a journey to become a Pokémon Trainer.
Now that I can go back to my old life...
Yeah, like hell I would.
Tch, I've been through some kinda mess in the time that I couldn't stay here.
Listen, kid.
If you ever offer someone to crash at your place, make sure you don't attach strings to it.
If any guy says you can crash at their place for free, don't believe them.
That's all I'm gonna say.
